positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceAsset
positions.frame: what distinguishes intelligence you own from intelligence you merely rent, and which part of that stack is the asset worth keeping?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same settled, plain-spoken antithesis at low arousal: src-2 sets owned against rented intelligence as a categorical distinction, and src-3 extends the same frame by assigning market-style value — commodity substrate versus kept-asset perspective. The register (aphoristic maxim), value (autonomy/self-enhancement), and relational (market-pricing) reads align across both, and conviction rises from claim to principle across the pair without breaking the shared antithesis — a single directional read spans them. No existing position in the consult addresses this distinction, so this is a fresh mint rather than an attach or revision.
